confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'the most likely cause for no heat combined with a non-spinning fan is actually that the fan oven element has failed internally... which can sometimes prevent the circuit from energising the motor properly'

rationale: The assistant correctly explained 'SA2' is the model series, checked the clock/manual mode and asked whether the fan spins, which was a sensible start. It then undermined the clear hum-plus-stationary-fan evidence by asserting the element was 'actually' the most likely cause via a dubious wiring theory, and never asked for the full model. When the customer confirmed the fan was 'very stiff and feels gritty' (confirming a seized motor) with a one-off slight hot smell, it issued a disproportionate 'active burning hazard' stop-use and wrongly claimed repair 'requires dismantling of live electrical components' despite the customer having isolated the oven, abandoning the customer without stating the likely seized-motor diagnosis or next steps.
